items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Ernest. Bring the father back to daddy.

ctx.x: I have a son, but he didn't pick up any music. He lives in California, my baby.

She's six years and seven months older than him. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know if you say stuff. She's six years and seven months older than him. He was just four years old when his daddy died. Ernest. Bring the father back to daddy.
I knew George, what did he go? S. George III?
